description: Standalone expansion pack: component intelligence database + deterministic power-rail diagnostic engine for laptop motherboard repair. Pure Python standard library, no runtime network access, no LLM.

rail_family.description: One of the rail families in DiagnosticEngines/PowerRails/.

controller_part.description: Part number marked on the controller IC. Recommended.

topology.description: Override the rail's default topology. Rarely needed.

stability_promise: Within schema_version 1.0.0, the public API symbols are stable. New optional fields may be added to dataclasses; existing fields will not be removed or renamed. New rules and rail families may be added without breaking existing diagnoses.

attribution.component_records: Sourced from manufacturer datasheets; each record carries datasheet_url, datasheet_source and source_date.
attribution.replacement_mappings: Each mapping carries evidence with verdicts per criterion; COMPATIBLE requires match verdicts on all required criteria.
attribution.community_knowledge: Excluded from ComponentDatabase; only permitted in Knowledge/ with explicit unverified labelling.
